I’m Dipesh Mishra. I enjoy the part where a complex problem becomes a system you can understand, operate, and trust.

At BrowserStack, that meant authentication migrations, large accessibility pipelines, and production incident resolution. At Meetandmore, it meant connecting bookings, payments, and real-time workflows through resilient services.

My project work ranges from Rizzerv’s production booking platform to Inovact’s AI hiring pipeline. I also make room for experiments: coding agents, conversational AI, and interactive 3D worlds.
